summary: Add a reliable browser command queue with request IDs, idempotency keys, tab/session affinity, typed results (page metadata, extracted text, screenshots), and explicit irreversible-action checkpoints. Replace the current single 45-second wait with progress events and resumable polling.
note: KEPT OPEN deliberately for one verified, still-true defect. Covered: request ids, tab/session affinity and typed results by local-agent/browserBridge.js + browserSessions.js (chg-bc35ae04 / chg-086a6904); idempotency keys now exist per action as content-addressed ids and are surfaced at GET /journal (chg-aace6694). NOT done, verified in the current source: local-agent/browserBridge.js:123 waitForBrowserResult(commandId, timeoutMs = 45_000) is still a single 45-second blocking wait, with COMMAND_LEASE_MS = 45_000 at browserBridge.js:5 — no progress events, no resumable polling. The "explicit irreversible-action checkpoints" clause is refused rather than pending: owner policy is no approval gates.
